hypothesis.rationale: Runtime-v2c r1 completed and tore down cleanly, but r2 was launched in the same recorded second and failed during the startup profile run with NVIDIA Xid 31. Requiring 90 consecutive seconds with no compute process before every server lifetime tests whether driver/context teardown was still racing the next startup. It changes server lifecycle only; no engine, model, request, task, or verifier setting changes.
hypothesis.falsification: Any failed quiescence barrier, startup, sentinel trace, sustained-use trace, or teardown rejects runtime-v2d.

evidence.host_kernel_event: NVRM Xid 31 MMU FAULT_PDE ACCESS_TYPE_VIRT_READ on GPU0 at 2026-08-20T17:53:55Z

evidence.inference: The upstream report supports treating the visible GEMM as a profile-run/runtime failure family; it does not establish that a quiescence barrier is a known fix.
